items.name: Brian Heder
items.desc: Old-school Keys drug runner. Jason works for him and lives under his roof.

items.name: Cal Hampton
items.desc: Jason's best friend in the Keys. Coast Guard radio, beers and conspiracy theories.

items.name: Donnie
items.desc: Brian's seaplane pilot in the Keys. Drops the packages, skims a little, deals on the side.

items.name: Jason Duval
items.desc: Army past, Keys present. Runs jobs for Brian Heder until Lucia walks out of prison.

items.name: Kat
items.desc: Lucia's friend from inside. Rich, pregnant, and posting from a yacht two weeks after release.

items.name: Lorena
items.desc: Lucia's tía up in Liberty State. Calls her Lucita, and money is tight in her house.

items.name: Lucia Caminos
items.desc: Liberty City born, raised to fight. Fresh out of Leonida Penitentiary on an ankle monitor.

items.name: Lori Heder
items.desc: Brian Heder's third wife. Sangria, a rifle within reach, and the Keys boat yard.

items.name: Raul Bautista
items.desc: Vice City bank robber shopping for talent. Pass his tests or stay out.

items.name: Tomás "Tommy" Caminos
items.desc: Tommy, to everyone close to him. First seen in the Prologue; the rest sits behind a click.

items.name: Vicki
items.desc: Room ten at the Starlet Motel. Dances at Delights, knows everybody in Port Gellhorn.

items.name: Andrea
items.desc: On Raul's crew. Runs the inside work, picks the cover names, expects you to keep up.

items.name: Boobie Ike
items.desc: Jack of Hearts owner, money behind Only Raw. Jason and Lucia's landlord.

items.name: Bush
items.desc: DWNPLY's personal bodyguard. Rolls with Cash City, the gang his boss pays to stay safe.

items.name: Doug
items.desc: Kingfishers man at the gang's camp. Brian drives out to settle the feud with him.

items.name: Dre'Quan Priest
items.desc: Jason's old friend. Runs Only Raw Records with Boobie Ike, and Real Dimez are his act.

items.name: Dunk
items.desc: Vicki's friend in Port Gellhorn. Jumpy pill dealer who swears it is all pharmacy grade.

items.name: Ernesto
items.desc: Raymond's partner. Only ever a voice on the phone.

items.name: Cisco
items.desc: Kordell's crew. Francisco on paper, Cisco on the gym floor, and somebody owes him money.

items.name: Karim
items.desc: Raul's tech man. Alarms, cameras, comms, and a laptop that never closes.

items.name: Kordell Grant
items.desc: KG. Bodybuilder, crew boss, ex-con. Runs his crew out of Ajax Gym and wants the whole city.

items.name: Mattia
items.desc: Kat's boyfriend from Vice City. Yacht money, Italian charm, a boss he never names.

items.name: Moses Watkins
items.desc: Port Gellhorn mechanic. Buys untracked cars, resprays, and registers your ride for a fee.

items.name: Nate
items.desc: Kordell's chattiest bodybuilder. Spots you, names you, and cannot keep a secret.

items.name: Niko Bellic
items.desc: The GTA IV man out of Liberty City, older and greyer, credited only as The Hitman.

items.name: Phil
items.desc: Owner of Phil's Ammu-Nation. More guns than the law allows.

items.name: Raymond
items.desc: San4San at the top of Venture Apartments. Holding bricks Boobie wants back.

items.name: Tyrone
items.desc: La Perle dealer. Buys what Jason flips and wants to know who cooks Kitty Litter.

items.name: Valentina
items.desc: Raul's money woman. Shell companies, offshore trusts and a lawyer for every problem.

items.name: Wyman
items.desc: Mechanic, collector and Mud Club regular. Brings wrecked classics back to life.

items.name: Yasmani Cabrera
items.desc: Smoke shop fence in Vice City. Buys hot jewelry and knows which safe holds what.

items.name: Abe Gonzalez
items.desc: Downtown lawyer. Says no deal in Vice City happens without him. Charges in favors first.

items.name: Aldo Méndez
items.desc: Task force captain. Walks into a Grassrivers interview with his crew and a lot of concern.

items.name: Andres de Leon
items.desc: MegaMundo's telenovela star, married to its COO. Needs bodyguards to stay on schedule.

items.name: Bae-Luxe
items.desc: The other half of Real Dimez. Never off camera, still chasing the DWNPLY hit.

items.name: César Navarro
items.desc: Runs MegaMundo. Petra's father, Andres's father-in-law, and nobody's pushover.

items.name: DWNPLY
items.desc: Leonida rap star. Cut the early hit that made Real Dimez.

items.name: Elonzo
items.desc: Steps off the jet with Andres de Leon. Talks big picture, producers and action roles.

items.name: Erin Henshaw
items.desc: Running for mayor of Ambrosia, with the sugar refinery behind the campaign.

items.name: Giorgio Gallo
items.desc: Shipping money and rooftop parties. His Bilgeco fleet sits idle in the bay.

items.name: Gustavo Herrera
items.desc: Head of security for the Navarro family at the MegaMundo opening.

items.name: Jimmy De Santa
items.desc: Michael's son from GTA V, now an influencer with crypto talk and a famous last name.

items.name: Joe
items.desc: Lucia's P.O. in the Keys. Wants his calls answered the first time, every time.

items.name: KD
items.desc: Vice City club promoter. Dre'Quan wants him on the roof to see the Dimez in action.

items.name: Kenton Rees
items.desc: Treasure hunter on Key Lento. Runs Island Dreams dive charters and buys what you pull up.

items.name: Mia Caminos
items.desc: Lucia's mother. New real estate business in Vice City, big plans, bigger optimism.

items.name: Petra Navarro
items.desc: MegaMundo's COO, married to its biggest star. Keeps opening night on schedule.

items.name: Rafa de León Navarro
items.desc: Andres and Petra's boy. The youngest Navarro, and the one the family guards hardest.

items.name: Roxy
items.desc: One half of Real Dimez with Bae-Luxe. Signed to Only Raw Records, chasing a second hit.

items.name: Rudi
items.desc: The Leonida Man. Climbed out of a moving pickup for the camera. RIP Rudi.

items.name: Sergeant Galecki
items.desc: Police sergeant at the Grassrivers Visitor Center. Asks his own questions, keeps his evidence.

items.name: Stefanie
items.desc: Lucia's counselor inside. Runs the supervised release that gets her out on a monitor.
